div.div: 7 انحنى It (a thing, S, as, for instance, a branch, or stick, TA) was, or became, bent, or curved; (S, K;) as also ↓ تحنّى : and the latter, it (a حِنْو, q. v.) was, or became, crooked. (TA.) [Also He bent, or bowed, himself.] And انحنى مِنَ الكِبَرِ [He became bent, or bowed, by reason of age]. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
